subject: maths
question:
In a circle with center O, two chords AB and CD intersect internally at point E. If ∠AEC = 95° and ∠AOD = 110°, then ∠BOC is equal

to:
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ In ΔAEC: ∠AEC + ∠ECA + ∠EAC = 180°. ⇒ ∠ECA = 1/2 ∠AOD, ∠EAC = 1/2 ∠BOC (angle at centre = 2 × angle at circumference) ⇒ 95 + 1/2(110) + 1/2 ∠BOC = 180 ⇒ 1/2 ∠BOC = 30 **∴ The correct answer is 60°.**
